messages:
maria: :rotating_light: Seeing a big spike in session invalidations and MFA prompts across prod-west and prod-eu starting ~09:11 UTC. ~2.1k affected users in last 10m. Alert linked: https://alerts.redwood.ai/ABCD1234
incidents-bot: [ALERT] auth.token_verification_failures rate 240/min (baseline 3/min) — created incident INC-2026-0421-1
alex: looking at auth logs — many failures show error=invalid_signature and verifier=okta-saml-handler from 09:10:56 onward
samir: did we rotate any KMS keys or change SSO certs around 09:10? I see a KMS rotation event at 09:09:58 for key redwood-auth-prod-primary on the audit trail
irene: confirmed KMS key rotation job ran at 09:09:58 UTC. rotation policy set to disable-old-key=false, but I see the public cert pushed to okta at 09:10:22 — possible timing gap.
alex: hypothesis: token signatures issued before rotation aren't being accepted briefly while the new key propagated -> session revokes + MFA pushes to re-auth. Could explain MFA fatigue.
jason: quick mitigation: re-enable acceptance of previous key for verification (grace window) and temporarily suspend forced session revocations for 15m. Will push change to auth-gateway now.
maria: @jason please also throttle MFA pushes to 1/min per-user in prod to avoid push storms. Notify CS to expect user tickets.
jason: applied: auth-gateway: set TOKEN_LEEWAY_PREV_KEY=1 and MFA_PUSH_RATE_LIMIT=1/min. Rolling to prod-west then prod-eu.
ops-bot: deploy auth-gateway v2026.04.21-rc2 -> prod-west succeeded (3/3). prod-eu in progress.
alex: after leeway enabled, invalid_signature errors dropped 95% in 3m. MFA push rate decreased. Session invalidations tailing off.
samir: good catch — root cause: KMS rotation + ~40s window where okta accepted new cert but our verifier hadn't loaded previous key. Need stronger coordination.
irene: containment checklist: 1) leeway accepted, 2) MFAs throttled, 3) CS paged with canned message, 4) watch dashboards for 60m.
maria: CS message drafted: "We're investigating an authentication disruption affecting sign-ins; temporary fixes are in place. If you see repeated MFA prompts, retry after a minute or contact support." Sending now. @jason thanks.
alex: For forensic: run this query to list users affected and last_error: ```SELECT user_id, count(*) AS failures, max(ts) FROM auth_logs WHERE error='invalid_signature' AND ts BETWEEN '2026-04-21T09:00:00Z' AND '2026-04-21T09:30:00Z' GROUP BY user_id ORDER BY failures DESC LIMIT 200;```
samir: I'm pulling the KMS audit trail and mapping rotations to deploy timelines, will attach to incident ticket.
irene: immediate post-incident actions (P0->P1): - add explicit pre-rotation propagation check for SSO cert publish - add metric for key-acceptance-failures - update runbook to include temp leeway flag and MFA throttling script - add automated rollback if invalid_signature spikes > 50/min
jason: created PR for runbook updates and an infra alert for token_verification_failures -> pager after 10min sustained at >50/min. PR: https://git.redwood.ai/r/runbooks/pulls/42
ops-bot: incident INC-2026-0421-1 status: mitigated -> monitoring (handed to eng-security).
maria: thanks all. We'll keep monitoring for 2 hours then draft a short postmortem. Assigning follow-ups: @irene owns KMS integration changes, @alex owns logging/queries, @samir owns audit mapping and timeline.
irene: noted. I'll also schedule a KMS vendor sync re: cert propagation guarantees.
alex: adding note to security-telemetry: correlate invalid_signature with session_revoke events so we can spot automated revokes tied to verifier failures.
maria: action items captured in INC ticket. Great teamwork — close the channel for comms, we'll reconvene for postmortem draft at 15:00 UTC. :white_check_mark:
